method: Fresh native Chrome uses raw catalog, translation, image/CC0 geometry registries and source display configuration as independent expectations. Tests first-fold natural-proportion female-image/enlarged-mainland-map layout, contained image content-box paint and surrounding frame/caption gaps in every source-correct state, 47 unchanged unique shapes/24 unique destinations, a labelled 44px Okinawa inset, native filled-path clicks and inset-label clicks, all24 source-correct states, URL/language/history behavior, Top10 ordering (regional image sizing is independently covered by check-region-photos), noJS, keyboard/touch, axe and zero external requests. No product purchase, retailer visit or Google map activation.
limits: Chrome emulation is not a physical Safari/iOS test. Natural proportions and contain/full-frame layout avoid CSS cropping or artificial letterbox bars, but do not inspect background pixels inside the original AI artwork or independently verify what it depicts. Bounce/retention is not measured.
